title: Feedback on Pollution Produced by Burning of Joss Paper and Incense
what_it_is: Feedback on Pollution Produced by Burning of Joss Paper and Incense

sections.label: Joss paper burning feedback decline
sections.summary: Feedback on joss paper and incense burning fell from about 1,100 instances in 2015 to about 500 in 2018.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: Feedback on joss paper and incense burning has been declining, from about 1,100 instances of feedback in 2015 to about 500 in 2018.

sections.label: Eco-friendly burners at columbarium, monastery
sections.summary: NEA introduced eco-friendly burners with a cyclone dust collection system at Mandai Columbarium, and Kong Meng San Phor Kark See Monastery installed one with an ash filtration system.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: For example, NEA has introduced eco-friendly burners with a cyclone dust collection system at Mandai Columbarium.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: The Kong Meng San Phor Kark See Monastery has also installed an eco-friendly burner with an ash filtration system to filter out fly ash.

sections.label: Large metal cage burner placement
sections.summary: Placing large metal cage burners in housing estates requires Town Council approval, normally via temporary occupation licence, with advice to keep them away from dense residential areas and encourage design improvements.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: In order to be able to place those large metal cage burners in housing estates, you need the approval of the Town Council.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Normally, the Town Council will allow this on a temporary occupation licence basis for a fixed period.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Our advice is for the Town Councils to ensure that these large metal cage burners are not located very close to dense residential areas, away from the residential areas.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Of course, we also encourage the industry to look into improving the design of these large metal cage burners, including, for example, containing the smoke coming out.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Indeed, we have worked with industry and other stakeholders to look at the trials of such eco-friendly burners and we will continue to assist in such trials to facilitate the adoption of technology, to mitigate smoke and fly ash emissions from burning, as long as there are parties who are willing to work with us.
